title: Where the design is silent, keep live core logic and match the design's look
context: A pre-mortem asked whether the viewer should show photos as the design's 2-column grid under the text or through the live reader with photos placed where written. The owner answered with a general rule.
options: Keep live core logic where the mock-up is silent, match its aesthetic
outcome: The owner: "the Claude Design just built a crude HTML mock-up of the Live Application. Where NOT specified, keep the established and well architected CORE logic of the live version because that is what is actually working. Do your best to match the aesthetic." The viewer therefore uses the live reader with placed photos. The owner did not object to two other defaults raised in the same pre-mortem: edit mode takes the design's header, and the month grid takes the design's cell styling.
